name: io.github.raceguard/raceguard
description: Find, prove, and repair read-decide-write races in Python HTTP handlers. Static scan is free; verification boots an ephemeral PostgreSQL and is budgeted.

environment_variables.name: RACEGUARD_MCP_ROOT
environment_variables.description: Project root every path is sandboxed to. Defaults to the working directory.

environment_variables.name: RACEGUARD_MCP_VERIFY
environment_variables.description: Set to false to disable verify_handler where Docker is unavailable.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from RACEGUARD_MCP_TOKENS on the server.
